Saturday morning, oat porridge, rain on the skylight. Catching up on a mad ten days.

## FreightTech, Thursday 6 Nov

Our talk was at 11:40 in Hall 2. Around 260 people, more than I expected for a talk about waiting trucks. Jens was brilliant on the bug story, got a real laugh with "two trucks, one door, zero chill". I rushed the first five minutes (again, talking too fast when nervous, Priya's note from June) and then settled. Q&A: 6 questions, one from a guy at DHL Supply Chain who wants a demo. Tomás counted 14 business cards afterwards. Ute did give permission for the 06:00 gate photo and it was the slide everyone photographed.

Hotel New York the night before, room 214 with a view of the Erasmusbrug. Second night I paid myself, worth it. Prep notes are in [[Conference talk proposal]].

## ACME

The other big thing. Call with Karin Wolters on Wednesday 12 Nov to close the renewal. She opened at €0.92, I said €0.84, we sat in silence for what felt like a minute. Landed at €0.86 for three years. I felt sick before the call and great after. Bas says the clauses are fine. All the numbers in [[Vendor contract renewal ACME]].

Things I'll do the same next time: write the walk-away number on a post-it and stick it on the screen. Things I won't: agree to call at 17:00 on a Wednesday when I'm already tired.

## Dinner with Wouter Kampstra

Friday at Restaurant Breda on the Singel, €78 each for the set menu, worth it. Wouter is back for good, took a job at Booking. We met in first year at the VU in 2010, he was the only other person in the tutorial group who'd done the reading. He told me about his divorce properly for the first time. I told him about Daan properly for the first time. Two hours. He's still going to Japan in April and still wants me to come.

## Book club

Wouter's joining the book club too. We're on Marcus Aurelius this month, which is a bit funny after my Seneca phase in spring. My notes for the session on the 27th go in [[Book club Meditations]]. Favourite line so far, Book 5, about getting up in the morning. Very relatable at 06:45 in November.

## The flat

Radiator in the bedroom cold at the top again. Bled it with the key from the kitchen drawer, half a cup of water, and it works. Followed [[Bleeding radiators]] step by step because last time I flooded the floor. Overmars finally fixed the bathroom fan in October, hygrometer now reads 61% after a shower.
